name: Do I need to do anything to prepare my home for siding replacement?
description: Prepare by clearing the home's perimeter, trimming shrubs, and securing indoor items. Hometelligent Inc. provides a pre-project checklist.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to do anything to prepare my home for siding replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, some preparation can help ensure a smoother siding replacement process. Before the crew arrives, homeowners should clear the perimeter around their house of any obstacles like patio furniture, plants, or decorative items. Trimming back shrubs or trees close to the house can also be beneficial. It's also advisable to remove wall-mounted items and secure loose objects inside that might be affected by vibrations. Hometelligent Inc. provides a pre-project checklist to clients in Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Dublin, or Emeryville to guide them through these preparations.
